title: React v2 Living Intake Wizard: Split-path wizard with modern 3D card flips and mission launch ceremony
goal: Rebuild the intake screen into a true 'Living System' experience. (1) Create a split-path entry: conversational AI intake on the left, visual tile wizard on the right. (2) The visual tile wizard uses 3D CSS card flips for selection, providing immediate tactile feedback. (3) Implement the 'Mission Launch Ceremony' from the design doc: when submit is clicked, show a dramatic full-screen overlay ('Mission locked. Deploying.') that fades out as the new Mission Control run card materializes and the scan map nodes appear.
scope: Intake screen and its transition to Mission Control.
generation_reason: The user requires a visually stunning, dynamic intake process with a 'wow' effect, moving away from static forms.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Focus strictly on the visual presentation and animations of the intake process and launch transition. Do not change the underlying backend submission logic.

success_criteria: Intake shows clear split between AI chat and visual tiles.
Clicking an assessment type tile performs a 3D flip animation.
Submitting the wizard triggers the full-screen 'Deploying' overlay.
Transition to Mission Control is seamless and animated.

acceptance_criteria: Intake wizard visually matches living system design and animates successfully.
